decisions.reason: The ticket-display statement is conditional and already covered by the requirement that automatically awarded tickets appear on the dashboard; the definitive new rule concerns randomly sent commissions.
The source requires commission data to appear on the dashboard and in NFT attributes, not a specific FAQ revision; the possible UI-note adjustment remains conditional on unresolved ticket behavior.
The source concerns display of randomly allocated no-code commissions, not the amount, trigger, recipient, destination, or timing of code-used referral commissions.
The random-recipient allocation policy remains unchanged; the new display/accounting obligation is already owned by the source requirement.
The source establishes dashboard and NFT-attribute accounting behavior and does not request any About-page copy change.
Adding randomly sent commission information to NFT attributes does not change the NFT's referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing methods, or referral-code display surfaces.
The source does not change referral-code validity, self-referral prevention, or validation feedback.
The commission-accounting decision has no effect on landing-page book-cover placement, size, cropping, or visibility.
The source concerns randomly awarded commission amounts on dashboards and NFT attributes, not public referral-count statistics on the leaderboard or landing page.
The source does not alter hero copy, layout, styling, or emphasis.
The source does not resolve whether no-code mints must generate tickets; it conditionally accepts either behavior, so the candidate's existing VALUE ambiguity remains unchanged.
The source requires operational display of random commissions and does not establish any landing-page mechanics-copy revision.
